entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="本気で言ってるの？ 私は鳥が懐かしいけど… 朝日と共に聞こえる鳥の歌声も…" t="You really don't miss anything? For me it's the birds – their songs in the morning..." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="本気で言ってるの？ 私は鳥が懐かしいけど… 朝日と共に聞こえる鳥の歌声も…" t="Serios, nu-ți e dor de nimic? Mie-mi e dor de păsări – ciripitul de dimineață..." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハトを忘れたのか？ 所構わずフンを撒き散らす、あの空飛ぶネズミどもを！ 鳴き声も最悪だ！ 自然が生み出した最悪の音だぜ" t="You forget about pigeons? Those flying rats shitting all over everything? And the cooing? Ugh, worst sound ever created by nature." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ハトを忘れたのか？ 所構わずフンを撒き散らす、あの空飛ぶネズミどもを！ 鳴き声も最悪だ！ 自然が生み出した最悪の音だぜ" t="Ai uitat de porumbei? Șobolanii ăia zburători care fac căcat peste tot? Și gugutul? Ugh, cel mai nasol sunet pe care l-a scos natura vreodată." b="" a=""/>
